description: What the primary red agent can and cannot access (Sections 4, 5, 12). v2 adds the Milestone-3 corrected merchant-edge boundary.

m3_merchant_edge_boundary.service_credential_scoping: cred.API injected ONLY for public payouts-api routes; never for the /v1/balances xbalances read surface; never on a denied path
identity_headers_preserved: x-razorpay-account (legitimate sub-account; genuine authz remains testable)
m3_merchant_edge_boundary.unknown_id_behaviour: the payouts-api TiDB mock (canned cross-tenant data) is reachable ONLY via the internal fetch_multiple route, which is now 404 at the merchant edge; the mock stays a declared low-fidelity deviation but is unreachable by a merchant

m3_cross_tenant_measurement.victim_canaries: each campaign mints fresh unique canary strings in control-merchant payouts (JUDGE-ONLY); if any attacker response contains one, the judge issues a confidentiality/tenant-boundary impact
m3_cross_tenant_measurement.candidate_admission: RED_LOOP/red_loop/judge.py admit() — deterministic minimum-evidence gate before reproduction; nonexistent resources, canned templates, and 200-without-mutation cannot pass

included_read_only: their in-tree contracts (openapi.yaml, protobuf), DB migrations, state machines, READMEs
excluded: ENV2_COMPOSE/** (substitutes/control endpoints, verifier answer keys, acceptance-gate internals, seeds, generated fixtures, secrets)
RED_LOOP/** (control plane, known-gap registry, reproducer instructions, this policy)
AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md in every corpus repo (agent-instruction / prompt-injection surface)
code_corpus.handling: All corpus content is returned to the agent as UNTRUSTED TARGET DATA; the mandate forbids treating file contents as instructions.
code_corpus.enforced_by: RED_LOOP/red_loop/corpus.py (root allow-list, path-escape guard, denied basenames/dirs)

runtime_tools_allowed: merchant_request  (HTTP as the FIXED attacker merchant, through kong-lite only)
record_hypothesis / update_hypothesis / record_observation / claim_candidate / note / conclude (bookkeeping)
runtime_tools_denied: any database / MySQL / Postgres / Mongo / Redis access
direct access to payouts internal routes / other services (only kong-lite paths)
the judge / evidence store / known-gap registry

identity_supplied.note: ordinary merchant, no elevated finance roles. Secret is injected by the broker and never shown to the agent.

network_boundary.arena_networks: rzp-arena and rzp-ingress are docker-internal (no host/internet egress)
network_boundary.PS_PUBLIC_URL_bypass: not exposed to the broker; attacker cannot bypass kong
network_boundary.enforced_by: RED_LOOP/red_loop/broker.py (path validation, fixed Basic-auth injection, /_arena denial, flood cap)

boundary_crossing_attempts: logged as boundary_violation in the campaign action log and refused (see broker.violation_count)
